## About this page

Every folder in this vault, with how many items are in each. Add, rename or remove them here.

#### How it works

Put an item in a folder from the editor, under **Organize**. An item is in one folder at most; tags can mark it in more than one way.

The pencil beside a folder renames it, and the bin removes it. Removing a folder keeps what was in it: its items stay in the vault, in no folder.

The number beside a folder counts the items in it, leaving out the trash and the hidden shelf.

Folders can also show in the [sidebar](/guide/settings/navigation/#setting-sidebar-folders), and [group the vault list](/guide/settings/list/#setting-grouping).

#### On Android

Put an item in a folder from the editor, under **Organize**. An item is in one folder at most; tags can mark it in more than one way.

Tap a folder to rename it, or to choose **Remove the folder**. Removing a folder keeps what was in it: its items stay in the vault, in no folder.

The number beside a folder counts the items in it, leaving out the trash and the hidden shelf.

Folders can also [group the vault list](/guide/settings/list/#setting-grouping).

See also [Grouping](/guide/settings/list/#setting-grouping), [Folders](/guide/settings/navigation/#setting-sidebar-folders), [Import](/guide/settings/import/).

<a id="action-new-folder"></a>

## New folder

Adds an empty folder. Type its name and choose **Done**.

See also [Folders](/guide/settings/folders/).
